params.rationale: primary route obstructed twice; fork to constructive complement

pending_actions.reason:
A route that produces the same obstruction twice in a row signals the
apparatus is in a basin the current substrate can't escape. Fork a
successor substrate with constructive-complement evidence (anchors
the obstructed route AS evidence, not as goal) so the next iter
attacks from a different direction.

Three consecutive iters at score 0 with no progress signals the
mutator is locked in. Per the fractal-de-anchoring memory: the
FRAME may be the suspect, not the form. Cold-shot a fresh model
with explicit de-anchoring discipline before continuing.
